nodes.label: RULE 0 — User instructions are blocking and authoritative
nodes.rationale: Explicit user instructions override the agent's own plan or judgment; reuse named existing sources before reinventing; disagree openly rather than disobey quietly. Ignoring instructions wastes the user's time, tokens, and money.

nodes.label: utxoWallet Native Android Clone Blueprint
nodes.rationale: Maps every token, component, screen, flow, and configurable of the utxoWallet dapp (source of truth: /Users/eurobuddha/Projects/utxoWallet/index.html v1.0.52) so the APK can be recreated exactly — cut no corners.

nodes.label: Runtime Design-Language Toggle (ORIGINAL / CURRENT)
nodes.rationale: Two switchable design languages chosen in CFG, persisted, applied app-wide via activity recreate(). All view code reads a central Design token object — never hard-coded colors — so the toggle is possible.

nodes.label: ORIGINAL Design Language (brutalist/terminal)
nodes.rationale: Faithful to the dapp: monospace everywhere, hard 1px borders, 0 radius, uppercase tracked micro-labels, tabular-nums; light and dark sub-modes with constant accent #ff5a1f.

nodes.label: CURRENT Design Language (native Material dark)
nodes.rationale: The existing native look: dark #0A0A0F bg, #15151F cards, accent #F7931A, rounded Material buttons, sans-serif; dark-only.

nodes.label: Send Flow (full transaction construction)
nodes.rationale: Core flow: record history → txncreate → txninput per coin → txnoutput recipient(s) → txnoutput change → txnsign with txnpostauto/txndelete. 64KB post-size guard with pre-flight estimateTxPowBytes; READ-mode pending sends become awaiting_approval and resume on NEWBLOCK (throttle 2 blocks, expiry 20 blocks).

nodes.label: Distribute Flow (auto-chained batches)
nodes.rationale: Batches of at most 14 address outputs, auto-chained via NEWBLOCK: batch1's change coin funds later batches. Affordability bug fix mandated: reject only if needed > total (strict), needed == total (zero change) must be ALLOWED — the current code wrongly rejects the equal case.

nodes.label: Split Flow (2–15 equal coins)
nodes.rationale: Each output = total/n rounded DOWN to token decimals with the last output taking the remainder, sent to N fresh getaddress outputs of the user's own wallet.

nodes.label: Consolidate Flow (merge coins)
nodes.rationale: No selection → node-native `consolidate tokenid:0x00`; 2+ selected → manual txncreate merging exactly those coins into one output at a fresh address. Full version offers dry-run preview (spent/created/net) and only posts if it reduces coin count.

nodes.label: Local SQLite Transaction History
nodes.rationale: The app keeps its own rich history (internalid, txnid, status, inputs/outputs JSON, changeaddr, burn, postblock) rather than relying on the node's `history` command, enabling resume/re-post/dismiss lifecycle states.

nodes.label: NEWBLOCK / NEWBALANCE Event Handling
nodes.rationale: NOTIFY events over IPC drive the app: NEWBLOCK updates block number, reloads coins, resumes pending sends, watches confirmations, and resumes distribute jobs; NEWBALANCE triggers a debounced reload.

nodes.label: PandaPools — Android
nodes.author: eurobuddha
nodes.rationale: Native Android constant-product AMM for Minima; MIT-licensed original code bundling Apache-2.0 Minima components (minimaapi.aar); release variant debug-signed for install parity; build pinned to JBR 21.

nodes.label: Constant-Product AMM over Aggregated Micro-Pools
nodes.rationale: Swaps are routed across every pool for a pair (water-filling by best price) and settle in one all-or-nothing transaction. LPs earn the 0.5% fee which accrues inside the pool (K grows) — deliberately no LP token.

nodes.label: 0.5% Pool Covenant (unique address per pool)
nodes.rationale: A pool is two reserve coins at a unique covenant address — the covenant's params are hardcoded literals, so the address is its script hash. Every post is gated on the covenant's own txncheck verdict; all fund math is exact (grain-floored, pool-favourable rounding).

nodes.label: KMIN Product Floor
nodes.rationale: The covenant enforces the constant-product invariant with a KMIN product floor specifically to defeat a dust-pairing drain that is unique to the UTXO/2-coin pool model.

nodes.label: 5-Layer Pool Recovery
nodes.rationale: Durable recipe persistence, re-track-on-launch, backup/restore, and faded-beacon re-announce, so the user can always find and withdraw pools even after a node resync or on a new device.

nodes.label: minimaapi Broadcast-Intent IPC
nodes.rationale: The app talks to a local Minima Core node on-device via the minimaapi broadcast-Intent IPC — no remote custodian or server.

nodes.label: PandaPools MiniDapp (shared registry sibling)
nodes.author: eurobuddha
nodes.rationale: The Android app shares the same mainnet registry and 0.5% covenant as the MiniDapp, so both trade the same live pools.

nodes.label: PandaPools Cloud Anchor — Beacon Re-announcer
nodes.rationale: Proactive, always-on beacon refresh replacing the app's reactive re-announce, which only fired after a beacon had already pruned (a guaranteed dark window) and was unreliable under Samsung Doze throttling of the 6h WorkManager. Diagnosed 2026-07-15 from live-chain data: 6 pools each had exactly one create-time beacon and the newest was ~18h old. Runs on the always-on eurobuddha megammr node (RPC 127.0.0.1:9005) via a systemd timer every 2.5h; re-announces before the ~24h prune when a funded pool's newest beacon exceeds PP_STALE_BLOCKS (~900 blocks / ~12h).

nodes.label: Pool Registry Beacon (unspendable sentinel dust)
nodes.rationale: A pool's registry beacon is unspendable dust at the sentinel 0x50414E4441504F4F4C53 that MMR-prunes ~a day after posting; beacons are grouped per pool by opk|tok|kmin state and refreshed by re-sending 0.000000001 MINIMA carrying the same state map verbatim.

nodes.label: Covenant Reconstruction and parseok Gate
nodes.rationale: The anchor reconstructs the 0.5% covenant byte-identical to PoolCovenant.TEMPLATE, gates on runscript parseok, derives the pool address, and only re-announces pools that are on-chain funded.

nodes.label: Anchor Fund-Safety Model
nodes.rationale: Read-only except a dust send to the unspendable sentinel, funded from the node wallet with change back. Never spends a covenant/pool coin, never signs an owner key — identical trust model to PoolManager.reannounce and the MDS poolmgr.reannounce.

nodes.label: Faucet Auto-Funding
nodes.rationale: Auto-tops-up from a co-located faucet when sendable < PP_MIN_SENDABLE; each beacon costs ~1e-9 MINIMA so a fraction of a MINIMA lasts years.
